description: Concurrent readers and writers access a Go map without synchronization.

candidates.title: Cache map is accessed concurrently without a lock

evidence.execution_path: Put and Get can execute in separate goroutines against the same Cache instance
evidence.violated_invariant: A Go map must not be read while another goroutine writes it without synchronization
evidence.falsifier_checked: The type contains no mutex and the methods do not require or assert external locking

candidates.impact: Production can hit a data race or fatal concurrent map read/write.
candidates.recommendation: Protect the map with a documented synchronization strategy.

verdicts.reason: Both unsynchronized access paths and the shared mutable map are present.
